turns.q: Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?
turns.replyTail:
damaged item is handled as a delivery or product incident instead. Please report delivery damage within 72 hours, and report any defect or incident found at delivery within 5 calendar days. Send clear photos or a video, and mention any reservations written on the delivery receipt. The return-cost rules for a change of mind do not automatically apply to damaged items.

For your case, please send your order number, purchase email and phone number, delivery date, and photos or video of the damage.
turns.replyText:
Yes. A normal return usually means the product does not suit you. For example, mattresses and other large items have a 100-night trial, while bed linen and mattress protectors have a 30-day return period.

A damaged item is handled as a delivery or product incident instead. Please report delivery damage within 72 hours, and report any defect or incident found at delivery within 5 calendar days. Send clear photos or a video, and mention any reservations written on the delivery receipt. The return-cost rules for a change of mind do not automatically apply to damaged items.

For your case, please send your order number, purchase email and phone number, delivery date, and photos or video of the damage.

turns.q: Do you need photos, and where do I send them?
Will I get a replacement or a refund?
turns.replyTail:
Neither outcome is automatic. The damaged item must first be assessed from clear photos or a video, a description of the damage, and your order details. After that review, the appropriate solution may be a replacement or a refund, depending on the situation.

Please send the photos or video, your order number, and the delivery details through the Tediber contact form. Report delivery damage within 72 hours and any defect or incident found at delivery within 5 calendar days.

turns.q: Do I have to pay anything to return the damaged item?
turns.replyTail:
The standard return fees for changing your mind do not apply to a damaged item. For a damaged or defective product, Tediber covers the return transport in the countries covered by its return service, including France, Belgium, Luxembourg, Spain, Italy, Switzerland, Germany, Austria and the Netherlands.

Please tell me the country the item would be returned from so I can confirm the applicable arrangement for your order. Please do not use the change-of-mind return fee schedule for this case.

turns.q: Can I keep the damaged item or must I ship it back?
Will the replacement ship with priority?
What if the replacement is also damaged?
turns.replyTail:
If the replacement also arrives damaged, report it as a new damage issue as soon as possible, ideally within 72 hours of delivery. Include a clear description, photos or a video showing the damage, your order number, and the delivery details.

The issue will be assessed again. If the defect is confirmed and covered, Tediber may arrange an exchange of the defective part or another replacement, depending on the situation. A further replacement or refund is not automatic.
